name: Taking Care Of Poor
overview: Scripture commands believers to care for the poor by intentionally leaving portions of their harvest for those in need and by responding with compassion rather than hardness of heart. God instructs His people to strengthen and relieve their impoverished brothers, including strangers and sojourners, ensuring they may live among them. Honoring God is closely tied to showing mercy to the poor, as oppressing them is equated with reproaching the Creator. Moreover, giving to the poor is seen as lending to the Lord Himself, promising a divine return for such generosity.
